tool_input.body:
## Summary

- Re-validated every volume-related bead against master and closed the **7** whose work had already shipped but was never recorded in the tracker. Each closure carries a `file:line` verification trail and the PR that fixed it.
- Re-scoped `xboing-c-4z4` rather than closing it — its code fix shipped, its tests did not, and two statements in the bead itself were wrong.
- Fixed the shipped packaging attribution: the metadata credited **"Justin Freeman"**, which is not anyone's name. It conflates the maintainer (J Freeman) with Justin C. Kibell, who wrote the original game in 1993–1996. This was user-visible in `apt show xboing`.
- Cleared lintian's `debian-changelog-has-wrong-day-of-week`; lintian now reports clean with zero warnings.

## Beads closed

| Bead | Shipped in | Verified at |
|---|---|---|
| `xboing-c-gyy` | #157 | 0 `sdl2_audio_play()` callers left; 29 `sdl2_audio_play_at_percent()` sites all carry volumes; all 5 scope additions from the bead notes checked individually |
| `xboing-uwk` | #196 | `game_rules.c:242-244` silent on dynamite spawn; regression test `test_game_rules.c:669` |
| `xboing-1xd` | #196 | `game_input.c:399` gates `SDL2I_ENTER_EDITOR` on `is_attract` |
| `xboing-2z1` | #196 | `sdl2_renderer_minimize` at `sdl2_renderer.c:237`, called `game_input.c:279` |
| `xboing-c0q` | #196 | `game_input.c:85` consumes the `SDL2I_START` edge after activate |
| `xboing-47p` | #194 + #196 | both halves: `=` debug skip at `game_input.c:255-274`, Delete alias via `dialogue_key_from_sdl` |
| `xboing-icp1` | #222 | `teams/xboing.yaml:17` lists the agent; `ethos doctor` exits 0, every check PASS |

`xboing-c-gyy`'s last outstanding acceptance criterion was the maintainer playtest of the audible dynamic range — confirmed 2026-09-07.

## Bead re-scoped, not closed

`xboing-c-4z4` (auto-cycle sound relay multi-fire). The fix shipped in #157 — all five relay-backing systems clear the one-shot sound register at the top of `_update()`, before the `finished` early-return. The **test half is missing**: every existing `get_sound` assertion only checks a sound *is* emitted, never that it clears. Two corrections went into the bead:

1. The shipped fix is its **option 3**, not the recommended option 2.
2. Acceptance criterion 2 was **unsatisfiable as written** — it asks that `get_sound` return NULL "even if update didn't run", which describes consume-on-read semantics option 3 does not provide. Rewritten to the shipped contract.

## Packaging attribution

`Justin Freeman` → `J Freeman` in `debian/control` (Maintainer), `debian/copyright` (Upstream-Contact), and two `debian/changelog` signatures — now matching the 13 other signatures already using that form. Kibell's own credit is untouched and remains correct (`debian/copyright`, `Files: original/*`, `Copyright: 1993-1996 Justin C. Kibell`).

Also: `26 Feb 2026` was a Thursday, not a Wednesday.

## Also carried

`.claude/agents/latex-tech-architect.md` — ethos SessionStart regeneration from team data, outstanding in the working tree.

No `Mission:` trailer: a bead sync, a generated agent file, and packaging metadata corrections are non-mission archetypes per `.claude/rules/delegation.md`.

## Test plan

- [x] `make check` green — exit 0, "All checks passed"
- [x] lintian clean, zero warnings (was 1: `debian-changelog-has-wrong-day-of-week`)
- [x] `ethos doctor` exits 0, every check PASS
- [x] `scripts/audio-literals.sh` passes
- [x] Backlog 34 → 27 open, 0 in progress
- [x] Every closure verified against master at `file:line`, not taken from the bead text
- [x] No source changes — `src/`, `include/`, `tests/` untouched

DEFECT 1 — the reporting line is emitted twice, in two different vocabularies.

  .claude/agents/latex-tech-architect.md:24   You report to Claude Agento (claude).
  .claude/agents/latex-tech-architect.md:73   You report to coo. These are not yours:

  latex-tech-architect.md  24 (claude)  /  73 (coo)

tool_input.body:
@copilot Both findings are correct, and I'm not fixing them in this PR. Reasoning, with evidence:

**These are generator output, not hand-authored content.** Per `CLAUDE.md`: *"Ethos generates `.claude/agents/<handle>.md` from team data at SessionStart."* The file in this diff is a regeneration artifact — it changed here only because the regeneration was sitting uncommitted in the working tree. Editing the artifact means the next session start overwrites the edit.

**Both defects are systemic, not specific to this file.** All five agent files carry them, and four are already on `master`:

Duplicated reporting line — identity in one place, role slug in the other:

| File | identity form | role-slug form |
|---|---|---|
| `latex-tech-architect.md` | :24 `claude` | :73 `coo` |
| `jck.md` | :24 `claude` | :138 `coo` |
| `jdc.md` | :23 `jck` | :96 `vision-keeper` |
| `gjm.md` | :23 `jck` | :106 `vision-keeper` |
| `sjl.md` | :23 `jck` | :97 `vision-keeper` |

The comma splice is the same story — the template interpolates `You are <Name> (<handle>), <description>` where `<description>` is a standalone capitalized sentence:

```text
You are Glenford J. Myers (gjm), Software testing pioneer. Wrote *The Art of ...
You are John D. Carmack (jdc), Game systems engineer. Shipped C and C++ ...
```

**So fixing one file by hand would be wrong three ways:** it gets reverted at next SessionStart, it leaves the set of five inconsistent, and it treats the instance instead of the class. This repo's `CLAUDE.md` is explicit — *"Single source of truth wins. When two places encode the same fact, drive one from the other"* and *"Fix the class, not the instance."* The single source here is the ethos template, which lives in a different repo.

Filed as **`xboing-qspw`** (P3) with the full file/line table and the acceptance criterion that regenerated files come out clean, to be fixed upstream in the generator.

Not carrying a `Mission:` trailer on this PR for the same reason the body states: a bead sync, a generated file, and packaging metadata are non-mission archetypes per `.claude/rules/delegation.md`.
